Polished detailed matte-digital illustration with convincing depth and subtle Aero glass reflections, tastefully nostalgic, quiet and architectural. Black-blue shadows rather than pure black. No neon cyberpunk, no purple or pink, no giant glowing sun, no planets, no sci-fi portal, no floating bubbles, no icons, no chat UI, no text, no logos, no people, no giant foreground objects, no product mockup, no decorative marketing elements.
